title: Shape-Aware Neural Time Fields for Rigid-Body Motion and Manipulation Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22762v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rigid-body motion planning is fundamental to robotic transport and manipulation, where both object position and orientation determine whether a body can move through cluttered environments. This coupling makes planning chal- lenging because translation and rotation can be constrained very differently by surrounding geometry. We propose Shape- Aware Neural Time Fields, a physics-informed neural motion planning framework that learns a reusable travel-time, or cost- to-go, representation for rigid-body motion while explicitly accounting for these distinct geometric restrictions. The learned field captures local motion difficulty in translation and rotation and is paired with a sampling-based planner that balances progress toward the goal with the cost of reaching nearby poses. translated_title: 面向刚体运动与操作规划的形状感知神经时间场
translated_abstract: 刚体运动规划是机器人运输与操作任务的基础，物体的位置和朝向共同决定了刚体能否在杂乱环境中移动。这种耦合使得规划极具挑战性，因为平移和旋转会受到周围几何环境截然不同的约束。我们提出了形状感知神经时间场，这是一种基于物理信息的神经运动规划框架，它为刚体运动学习一种可复用的行进时间（即代价至终，cost-to-go）表示，同时显式地考虑这些不同的几何限制。所学习的场能够刻画平移与旋转中的局部运动难度，并与一个基于采样的规划器相结合，该规划器在向目标推进与到达邻近位姿的代价之间进行权衡。我们在二维和三维刚体规划任务以及通过物体推挤实现的非抓取操作任务中，在多样化环境下对该框架进行了评估。结果显示……
tldr: 提出形状感知神经时间场框架，通过学习可复用的行进时间表示来显式刻画刚体平移与旋转所受的不同几何约束，并结合基于采样的规划器，实现高效的刚体运动规划与非抓取操作规划。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Shape-Aware Neural Time Field framework that learns a reusable travel-time representation explicitly capturing the distinct geometric constraints on rigid-body translation and rotation, paired with a sampling-based planner for efficient rigid-body motion planning and non-prehensile manipulation.
